images.filename: StateLibQld 1 102399 Angela Casey, Enid Maxted, Albi Maxted and Mrs Maxted at Doomben Races, Brisbane, 20 May 1933.jpg
images.caption:
Angela Casey, Enid Maxted, Albi Maxted and Mrs Maxted at Doomben Races, Brisbane, 20 May 1933
George Maxted owned Yeddo, a Japanese style house, at New Farm. Yeddo was brought piece by piece from Japan and was described at the time as the only truly Japanese house in Queensland. Mrs George Maxted was a well known Brisbane socialite. (Description taken from: Sunday Truth, 17 November 1935, p. 34.).

images.filename: StateLibQld 1 83831 Doomben Cup being presented to owner-trainer Harry Lee, Doomben, 1950.jpg
images.caption:
Doomben Cup being presented to owner-trainer Harry Lee, Doomben, 1950.
Premier of Queensland, Hon. Edward Hanlon, presents the Doomben Cup for 1950 to owner-trainer Harry Lee, who won with his three year old filly Dream. Apprentice jockey Jim Denman, who rode Dream, watches the presentation. (Description supplied with photograph.).
images.alt:
Doomben Cup being presented to owner-trainer Harry Lee, Doomben, 1950.
Premier of Queensland, Hon. Edward Hanlon, presents the Doomben Cup for 1950 to owner-trainer Harry Lee, who won with his three year old filly Dream. Apprentice jockey Jim Denman, who rode Dream, watches the presentation. (Description supplied with photograph.).

images.filename: StateLibQld 1 104136 Esma Quinn and Gwen Johnson at the Doomben races, Brisbane, 29 July 1933.jpg
images.caption:
Esma Quinn and Gwen Johnson at the Doomben races, Brisbane, 29 July 1933
Miss Esma Quinn and Miss Gwen Johnson seemed to be in the throes of a punting problem when 'Truth's' cameraman made this snap at Doomben yesterday. (Description taken from: Sunday Truth, 30 July 1933, p. 2) Esma Quinn was a member of a well-known Brisbane Hotel family. (Description supplied with photograph).

images.filename: StateLibQld 1 124915 Mr. D. W. H. Kenyon, Joan Charters and June Shepherd at the Doomben Races, Brisbane, 1940.jpg
images.caption:
Mr. D. W. H. Kenyon, Joan Charters and June Shepherd at the Doomben Races, Brisbane, 1940
Caption: 'Trio who chatted together on the lawn yesterday afternoon at Doomben (left to right): Mr. D. W. H. Kenyon of the R.A.A.F., Joan Charters and June Shepherd.' Mr. Kenyon appears to be wearing his R.A.A.F. uniform, while Miss Charters is wearing a jacket over a cashmere sweater and a fur lined toque tied at the back of her head with a bow. Miss Shepherd is wearing a long, fur-like coat, matched with a dramatic hat with an upturned brim.
images.alt:
Mr. D. W. H. Kenyon, Joan Charters and June Shepherd at the Doomben Races, Brisbane, 1940

images.filename: StateLibQld 1 125887 Edna Mann and Edna Parkes at Doomben Races, Brisbane, 1938.jpg
images.caption:
Edna Mann and Edna Parkes at Doomben Races, Brisbane, 1938
Caption on photo: Edna Mann (left) was one of the girls at the races who decided that a 'hat in the hand was worth two in the bush' in yesterday's high wind over Doomben. Edna Parkes (right), who is off to Tasmania by the Kanimbla on a month's tour next week, did a bit of mild punting towards the trip yesterday at Doomben.
